cases.name: talon-knight-full-figure
cases.prompt: Dark fantasy character concept sheet, full figure, the Talon Knight: weather-beaten plate and ragged cloth, a heavy hooked war-hammer slung over one shoulder, one forearm wrapped in a shield-gauntlet of scarred iron and brass, a tall crested helm, a hunting bird perched on the raised gauntlet. Standing on a windswept moor under an overcast sky, distant crags. Painterly oil illustration, cinematic rim light, muted earth tones with a single crimson sash, intricate but grounded detail.
cases.video_prompt: Slow push-in as wind moves the ragged cloth and the hunting bird ruffles its feathers, overcast light shifting

cases.name: talon-knight-woodcut
cases.prompt: Medieval woodcut engraving of the Talon Knight, bold crosshatched black ink, the knight with hookhammer and shield-gauntlet, a great bird wheeling overhead, esoteric knotwork border, aged parchment texture, sepia wash over black ink, high contrast, tabletop rulebook plate style.
cases.video_prompt: The engraved lines gently shimmer and the bird's wings beat slowly, ink bleeding outward as parchment grain drifts

cases.name: talon-knight-stained-glass
cases.prompt: Gothic stained-glass window panel of the Talon Knight, thick black lead lines, jewel-toned glass, a spread-winged bird haloed behind the knight's helm, shafts of coloured light, cathedral interior glow, luminous, symmetrical composition.
cases.video_prompt: Light moves through the glass so the jewel colours glow and shift, dust motes drifting in the beams

cases.name: flockbond-vision
cases.prompt: Surreal double exposure: the Talon Knight's profile dissolving into the eye of a hawk in flight, an aerial view of moorland far below seen through the bird's vision, claw and eye and wing interwoven in a dreamlike loop, ethereal teal and gold light, painterly. The motto made visible — the claw is nothing without the eye, the eye is nothing without the wing.
cases.video_prompt: The hawk's eye slowly turns and the landscape below sweeps past as if the camera is soaring, clouds parting

cases.name: regret-burning
cases.prompt: The Talon Knight kneeling before a small fire at dusk, feeding a torn banner and folded letters into the flames, embers rising as pale smoke, heavy release on the face, low-key chiaroscuro, painterly, desaturated tones with a warm ember glow on the armour, ash drifting on the wind.
cases.video_prompt: The fire flickers and embers spiral upward, the knight's shadow swaying, ash drifting across the frame

cases.name: old-steed
cases.prompt: The Talon Knight standing beside an old, scarred warhorse in rain-soaked earth, one gauntleted hand resting on its neck, both weathered by long roads, overcast dawn light, muted palette, painterly realism, gentle dignity.
cases.video_prompt: The old steed shifts its weight and exhales steam in the cold dawn, the knight's hand steady on its neck

cases.name: helm-black-cloth-white-ravens
cases.prompt: Close-up still life: the Talon Knight's crested helm resting on a slab of stone, a black cloth draped beneath it, a scattering of coins at its base, pale white ravens gathering in the gloom around it, dark and nurturing and eerie, shallow depth of field, cinematic painterly light.
cases.video_prompt: A white raven hops closer and tilts its head, the black cloth stirring faintly, the coins catching the light

cases.name: veiled-seer
cases.prompt: A towering, androgynous figure robed in hanging folds of flesh and long horse-like hair that hide any semblance of a face, blind yet aware of everything within a hex, standing in a dim stone hall, a single word of advice hanging in the air as a ripple of light, ominous yet serene, dark fantasy oil painting, low candlelight.
cases.video_prompt: The veiled figure turns slowly, the folds of flesh and hair shifting like a curtain, candle flames bending toward it

cases.name: loyal-bird-study
cases.prompt: Natural-history study plate of the Talon Knight's hunting birds: a fisherhawk diving toward water, a cave owl in shadow, a grey raven, a red eagle, a rock falcon, and a bog vulture, arranged like an old bestiary engraving with fine labels, dark fantasy tone, detailed and painterly on aged paper.
cases.video_prompt: The engraved birds subtly ruffle and one wing beats as the page texture breathes, ink shifting
